settings.label: Free UAE delivery threshold (AED)
settings.info: UAE domestic orders only. The cart and product-page progress bar is hidden for shoppers in other markets, which have higher thresholds.

settings.content: One switch for the whole sale: the announcement bar, the hero pill, product-card badges, the product-page code card and the cart reminder. Turn it off and every piece disappears at once.

settings.label: Discount code
settings.info: Shown to shoppers exactly as typed. It must match a live code in Discounts, or the storefront is advertising a code that does not work.

settings.label: Code value (%)
settings.info: Keep in step with the discount in Discounts.

settings.label: “Up to” headline (%)
settings.info: The best saving already shown on a product before the code is applied. Set it at or below the real best saving in the catalogue.

settings.label: Ends at
settings.info: Store time, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. Drives the countdown and hides the sale on its own once the moment passes. Set it to the same moment as the discount's end date in Discounts.
